observed_value: comparative-period position retained in the 2026-03-31 holdings dataset

findings.detail: A comparative-period DynaGrid Class A-2 Units row was retained even though the same instrument and amounts appear in the current-period schedule.
The retained comparative DynaGrid row duplicates the current-period DynaGrid row at table 19 row 32.

rationale: PP03 is a real data error. The filing presents the same DynaGrid Class A-2 Units position in the current schedule (table 19 row 32) and in the earlier comparative schedule (table 31 row 12), with identical par/shares, cost, and market value. Retaining the earlier-period fact in the 2026-03-31 holdings dataset is a comparative-period extraction leak and creates a duplicate position. The queue reports ten rows with this period-contamination shape; the cited DynaGrid pair directly grounds the mechanism.
